result.summary: Found one major issue: the featured 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a broken image placeholder instead of the restaurant's photo. Everything else on the page renders correctly.

issues.description: The image for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' fails to load and shows a generic broken-image placeholder icon, making the featured card look unfinished compared to other cards that display photos.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL or asset loading for this restaurant card, and add a fallback (e.g., cuisine-themed placeholder image or brand color background) so a broken-image icon is never shown to users.
